tool.name: cache_deception_check
tool.description:
Probe a URL for web cache deception. Detects whether a CDN / front-end cache will cache an authenticated response when the URL is suffixed with a static-asset-shaped extension or path-traversal-style delimiter — the classic Omer Gil 2017 vector for harvesting other users' authed content.
Methodology (single pass per scan, auth-injection from `--auth-*` flags applied automatically):
1. Fetch the canonical authed path → baseline (status, body, cacheability). 2. Generate ~15 deception-shaped variants and fetch each with the same auth. 3. Flag variants where body fuzzy-matches baseline (length ±5% AND token Jaccard ≥ 0.85) AND response is cacheable.
Variants:
| Class | Variants | |---|---| | static-extension confusion | `.css`, `.js`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.ico` | | delimiter path-traversal | `/x.css`, `/.css`, `%2fx.css`, `//x.css` | | matrix-URI / Tomcat | `;.css`, `;x.css` | | byte-truncation | `%00.css`, `%0d.css`, `%23.css` | | query-strip | `?x=.css` |
Severity tuning:
- **High** (CWE-525, web_cache_deception) — body matches baseline AND cacheability is `cacheable_explicit` (Cache-Control: public / max-age) or `cached_already` (Age, X-Cache HIT, CF-Cache-Status HIT). - **Medium** (CWE-525) — body matches baseline AND cacheability is `ambiguous` (no explicit Cache-Control, no cache-hit signals; absent explicit `no-store` real-world CDNs default-cache static-extension responses). - *(no finding)* — body diverges from baseline (origin correctly distinguishes paths) OR variant returns 4xx / redirect / error OR Cache-Control: no-store/private.
Per-class dedup: at most one finding per (severity × variant class) so a `dot_css` + `dot_js` + `dot_png` static-extension cohort generates one finding, not three.
Skip / soft-fail: - Baseline not 200 (nothing to cache-deceive). - Baseline body < 80 bytes (too short for fuzzy-match). - Baseline excluded by `--exclude-path`.
Each finding includes `description_plain` + `recommended_action` (the §11 non-tech UX fields) — recommends back-end refusal of non-canonical extensions, CDN cache-key configuration to match only `/static/*` / `/assets/*`, OR `Cache-Control: no-store` on every authenticated dynamic endpoint.
Read-only (GET only, no follow-redirects). Composes with cluster-A safety: `--exclude-path` / `--rate-limit` / `--auth-*` apply to every variant automatically.

parameter.name: target
parameter.description: URL to probe — typically an authenticated page (e.g. `https://app.example.com/account`). Bare hostnames are auto-prefixed with `https://`.

returns.description:
{success, target_url, target_host, baseline: {status, body_length, body_hash, cacheability}, variants: [{label, url, mutation_note, class_, status, body_match: {match, length_ratio, jaccard}, cacheability, finding_severity, evidence}, ...], findings_emitted}.
The agent should follow up high-severity findings by fetching the same variant URL anonymously (no auth) and confirming the cached authenticated body is returned to a fresh client.
